claims.promise: The contractor can keep separate daily logs for several active sites and switch between them without dumping every location into one notebook page.

evidence.finding: My Daily Report App (com.snappii_corp.my_daily_report_app, 50K+, 3.3★) critical review: "I go to 6 different locations and want to be able to do an activity log for each site"; printed by node scripts/scan-complaints.mjs --query "construction daily report".

comparison.limitation: User reports having to force every site into one page or export each report to phone storage separately.

claims.deferredReason: No project model exists yet; proof requires tests that create two sites and attach dated entries to each without cross-mixing.

claims.promise: Each daily entry can carry photos with captions and an optional site/location tag written beside the work note, so the report matches what a superintendent expects to read.

evidence.finding: Same Snappii app, 3★ review: "you can add photos but not captions… tag the locations for each entry"; printed by the same scan-complaints run.

comparison.limitation: Photos without captions and without per-entry location tags for multi-site work.

claims.deferredReason: No entry editor exists; proof requires UI/unit tests that persist caption text with an image URI on an entry.

claims.promise: The finished daily report leaves the phone as a shareable PDF (or system share sheet) the office, owner or GC can open without installing Crewday.

evidence.finding: Among 11 critical reviews in the pocket sample, missing-feature was 27% (3/11); the 50K+ Snappii app (3.3★) review says after each report "it makes you save it to your phone" and wants "each document be one daily report" — the handoff the PDF/share promise finishes.

comparison.limitation: Forces per-report save-to-phone friction instead of a single composed daily document handoff.

claims.deferredReason: No PdfDocument / ACTION_SEND path exists; proof requires an export test whose PDF contains site name, notes and captioned photo placeholders.

claims.promise: Unlimited sites and exports after one purchase — no yearly renewal and no ads interrupting a site walk.

evidence.finding: Pocket complaint profile: paywall 45% of critical reviews; docplan verbatim "$40/year" and "paid for yearly subscription and still… locked all the functions"; enrich shows ads+IAP on Snappii 50K+ cards.

claims.deferredReason: No billing product exists; proof requires a one-time Play Billing SKU, no subscription product, and no ads SDK in the release classpath.
